Conditional-mean variants are more conservative (T:cams/cmean J 385.5; cmean_s 383.7); env8 has 0.15 rho=.95 promotion but a declared rho<=.8 assumption. Twin promotion rates vary widely: T:cams/a5b .075-.092 on four twins and 0 on twin_metro; cmean .009-.442. These one-seed-per-twin rates are descriptive only.
T4.track_R: Track-R alpha calibration and evaluation are in outputs/sprint2/T/trackR.json. R20: T:cams/a5b: alpha 0.5, eval risk 0.037 [0.013,0.105], cost 381.6 [375.8,387.4], Pareto; T:cams/a5b+ad: calibrated alpha 0.05; no displayed R20 Pareto point; T:cams/cmean: calibrated alpha 0.05; no displayed R20 Pareto point; T:cams/env8: calibrated alpha 0.05; no displayed R20 Pareto point. Curves are selected-grid empirical estimates, not guarantees.
T4.track_V: CAMS adapter: 20/20 F0 null, 10/20 F0 worse, 19/20 on each rho=.8 and rho=.95 screen. Conditional-mean variants are more conservative; these rates are diagnostics, not a guarantee. See family_t/results.md.
T4.disposition: Evidence mechanism materially changes risk/cost; CAMS raw performance is not a safe result due to null promotions.

T5.implementation: T4-selected evidence/module wrappers evaluated on Model Picker and Model Selector hosts; shared gate wrappers.
T5.track_E: The frozen A5b setting transfers with zero promotions on F0/F0_worse/rho=.8/rho=.95 dev null screens, but is more costly than host adapters: T:mp/a5b 397.7 vs model_picker_adapter 354.4; T:ms/a5b 395.8 vs model_selector_causal 347.0. Conditional-mean variants reduce but do not eliminate rho=.95 promotions (MP .50/20, MS .45/20). Markov env8 transfers with observed rho=.95 promotions (MP .20, MS .20), consistent with its declared rho<=.8 restriction. These are simulator transfer results; real summaries are heterogeneous.
T5.track_R: See `docs/sprint2/family_t/T1_T2_T5_trackR_followup.json` and `docs/sprint2/family_t/T1_T2_T5_trackR_followup.md`. Post-development follow-up evaluates the shared wrapper on CAMS, Model Picker and Model Selector with 20 development and 20 separate evaluation seeds per regime on the eight-alpha grid. T:mp/a5b is 383.7 at risk .050 [.020,.122]; T:ms/a5b is 383.2 at risk .0375 [.013,.105]; T:cams/a5b is 381.9 at risk .050 [.020,.122]. These are local follow-up operating points, not a cross-family frontier or transfer guarantee. See `family_t/T1_T2_T5_trackR_followup.md` and manifests.
T5.track_V: Fixed A5b setting: 0/20 on F0, F0_worse, rho=.8 and rho=.95 on both MP and MS hosts; env8 has 4/20 rho=.95 promotions per host, outside declared rho<=.8 region. Twin checks are one seed per split. See family_t/results.md.
T5.disposition: The fixed setting transfers procedurally, not as an economic improvement or broad validity guarantee.

T6.implementation: Evidence x acquisition 2x2: A5b or env8 with C2/C6 and front/base acquisition on gated host.
T6.track_E: For A5b x C2 the estimated interaction is +0.8 [-1.5,+3.0] in dev; acquisition effect at best evidence is -0.6 [-1.9,+0.7]. A5b x C6 interaction is also recorded in contrasts.json. T6:a5bxC2 has 0/20 promotions on the four dev null screens and alternative mean J 391.1; the comparison to the prior selected `choe_ramdas_eb+front` port is historical and exploratory; that non-author-native port cannot support published-SOTA inference. Track-R points are reported, e.g. at R20 risk .087 [.043,.170], cost 374.2 [368.7,379.8] at alpha .5. Fresh-real comparison to A5b is mixed; twin promotion ranges 0-.083 for T6, one policy seed per split.
T6.track_R: Track-R alpha calibration and evaluation are in outputs/sprint2/T/trackR.json. R20: T6:a5bxC2: alpha 0.5, eval risk 0.087 [0.043,0.170], cost 374.2 [368.7,379.8], Pareto; T6:a5bxC6: calibrated alpha 0.05; no displayed R20 Pareto point; T6:env8xC2: calibrated alpha 0.05; no displayed R20 Pareto point; T6:env8xC6: calibrated alpha 0.05; no displayed R20 Pareto point. Curves are selected-grid empirical estimates, not guarantees.
T6.track_V: T6:a5bxC2: 0/20 promotions on the four development null screens; interaction estimate is small/uncertain. Twin rates 0–.083 from one policy seed per split. See family_t/results.md.
T6.disposition: No evidence of an interaction gain; retain the null interaction estimate and scoped cost-risk curves.

P1.track_E: vs A5b: P1_renew F5_dep_better_r8 -14[-26,-1], S_reversal_400 -31; but F0_better +27, F9_bursty +47, P_hmm/piecerho +38/+39; real +97/+139 on bike/metro, -9/-16 beijing/household. c_corr spacing: ~0 everywhere.
P1.track_R: P1_renew: R5 at alpha .3 risk .025 cost 397.1; R10-R30 cost 388.0; not on frontier (A5b 384.0)
P1.track_V: V2 (renewal: proved for first-order chain with i.i.d. gaps; union by Bonferroni). 0/20 on all 10 dev nulls incl. 5 misspecified; twin P1_renew 0/200, P1_union <=.05. P1_cap95 V2 only rho<=.95 (.20 at rho .98). P1_capmix INVALID (.90 at r95, 1.00 at r98).
P1.disposition: Diagnosis: free-rho absorption is 1.2-1.5 nats and Fisher efficiency loss <=4%; the dominant losses are persistence itself and alt-mixture misfit. The sprint-1 figure (18.5 of 20.5 nats) was not reproduced; the oracle at p=.65, rho=.8, 100 queries is 2.4-4.0 nats. No construction recovers net power.
P1.next_action: Do not advance. If revisited: alt-mixture prior with mass on persistent alternatives (alt misfit 1-3 nats).

P2.track_V: V1 vs V2 error rates reported separately: D2 V2 .308 / V1 .142; QSG .358/.183; RMM .308/.125; GAR+front .175/.067; A5b 0/0
P2.disposition: Analysis result: in tested delay-100 synthetic episodes, M and Cpol correlations with realized A500 were .86/.74/.52 at rho 0/.8/.95; at rho=.95, Cstate=.53 while M=Cpol=.52. Similar correlations do not make conditional and marginal hypotheses equivalent. At short delay/high rho, mean A500 was +8.6 on p=.5 null episodes (rho=.95, delay=1). On reused twins, selected promotions had positive mean realized A500 for four displayed certified methods (+6 to +19), which does not estimate persistence duration or transfer. Status means 'analysis complete'; this is not a candidate.
P2.next_action: Use V2 as the safety target under the frozen contract; report V1 separately

P3.track_E: P3_follow beats the best other policy at rho=.95, delay 1, cs<=2 (margins -79.5 to -11.6 for tested p), plus one low-cost cell p=.5, rho=.8, delay 1, cs=.5 (margin -1.8). At delay 100 it loses across all tested p/rho settings, by +14.0 to +669.5 over reweighted switch costs cs=.5,2,5,20; the full-grid maximum loss is +738.4 at p=.50, rho=0, delay=1, cs=20. In the 23-regime, 20-seed dev screen, paired mean J is +37.2 to +163.0 vs A5b.
P3.track_V: none (uncertified); null promotion 1.00 on all nulls, twins .875-1.0
P3.disposition: In displayed promoted cells, certified-method ΔJ at delay 100 ranges +14.9 to +83.4; at rho=.95 and delay=1 it ranges -12.6 to +21.0 by method/p. Aggressive switching is never better under the frozen contract (delay 100, cs=5). The cs sweep is reproducibly reweighted from saved fixed-cs trajectories; policies were not rerun at each cost.
P3.next_action: Record as scoping evidence; no advance

P4.track_E: on misspecified alternatives A5b ~ never-switch on order2/Markov (410/417 vs 405/421) and better on HMM/piece-rho (364/375 vs 421/423); D2 346-356
P4.track_V: Development screen: A5b 0/20 on all tested nulls except HMM 3/20. Round-5 HMM stress replay: A5b 176/1000 [Wilson .154,.201], P1_renew 54/1000 [.042,.070], P1_union 44/1000 [.033,.059], D2 256/1000 [.230,.284], RMM 250/1000 [.224,.278]. The HMM is outside A5b/P1's declared first-order Markov null; this does not test their in-class guarantees.
P4.disposition: The 1,000-seed HMM replay confirms elevated A5b promotions under this specific out-of-class generator. It quantifies a limitation; it is not an in-class guarantee failure or evidence that other misspecified classes are safe.

P5.track_E: K_D2 vs native CAMS(K): nulls -48/-68, K3_near -22, K4_late -21, real -16 to -30 (household -23+-17, metro -19+-14); vs Model Picker(K) within noise except metro +22.7; vs never real -80 to -578
P5.track_R: Separate K3/K4 Track R in outputs/sprint2/P/trackR_K/risk_curves.json. Development-only calibration/selection, 20 seeds per regime, separate 20-seed evaluation blocks. Pooled K3/K4 null ever-nonbetter deployment risk: R5 alpha .2, eval .025 [.000,.074], alt net J 565.2 [560.4,570.0]; R10 alpha .3, eval .050 [.000,.117], J 563.5 [556.2,570.8]; R15-R30 alpha .5, eval .150 [.047,.253], J 556.5 [550.2,562.7]. Cost selected on development alternatives. Empirical K-model panel, not comparable to pooled two-model families or a guarantee.
P5.track_V: V1 (pairwise Bonferroni, conditional only if each pairwise sign null holds under the full pre-label query selection, including host preference and cross-pair shared-label triggers; not merely its own queried-disagreement null). K3/K4 null .05 (native CAMS/MP .95-1.00); real proxy .00-.21. Empirical rates do not verify the selection-conditional assumption.
P5.disposition: Development evidence in tested K=3-4 settings; no general transfer claim. No certified published K-model comparator exists; misses late improvement.
P5.next_action: No further Track-R gap for the tested K=3/4 simulator; any confirmatory K-model claim needs preregistered regimes, larger independent seed blocks and independent review of the cross-pair selection null.

P6.track_E: 20-seed development screen: P6_LRMD_U vs M_LRMD_SUI: F1_late_800 -9.0[-14.3,-3.7], F1_late_1200 -11.8, W_late_1000 -10.1, S_reversal_400 -25.9; vs xu_acquisition_only (Xu acquisition + ShiftLab paired V1 certificate; not Xu et al.'s published certificate) -17.5/-15.9/-12.1; costs F0_better +7.7, F5_better_r8 +13.2; real +6 to +78 vs M_LRMD_SUI. P6_RRD ~ A5b (no late gain). Post-development 20-seed-per-episode all-14-source replay (seed base 2026110902) gives equal-source mean P6_LRMD_U cost 525.24 versus 500.83 for M_LRMD_SUI, 495.69 A5b, 404.92 D2, 423.47 RMM, and 414.14 gated adaptive-range; P6 costs 24.41 more than its parent on equal-source paired means (higher on 11 sources, lower on 2, tied on 1). It is 72.65 cheaper than never-switch on equal-source means. This is a post-development replay of exposed sources, not late-change or independent-transfer evidence.
P6.track_R: 20-seed development screen: P6_LRMD_U R5-R30 at alpha .5, risk .050 [.014,.165], cost 390.8 (not on frontier); P6_RRD R5 risk .050, cost 383.8 (on frontier); A5b R5 risk .025, cost 384.0 (on frontier). P6_RRD and A5b have near-equal point costs at different observed risk.
P6.track_V: V2 (UniformStartSUI weights sum to 1; fam_a Markov-SUI argument). Dev nulls 0/20 except HMM .05 (LRMD_U) / .20 (RRD); prior twin screen P6_LRMD_U .000-.100; 1,000-seed bike-hour follow-up .076 (split-cluster 95% CI [.036,.122]), upper bound exceeds .0936, P6_RRD .000-.025
P6.disposition: In the tested no-host synthetic paired ablation, the uniform start prior lowered late-regime costs relative to M_LRMD_SUI; this does not establish it as the dominant cause of all Amendment-6 loss. Host integration still fails. The all-14-source post-development replay shows no average cost gain over the parent or named deployment comparators; retain P6 only as a scoped synthetic mechanism result.
P6.next_action: Do not claim real transfer or advance P6 as a real-data winner. Any continued method claim requires a changed mechanism and a frozen independent-source evaluation; the present all-14 replay is retrospective and economically unfavorable to P6 against its parent and deployment comparators.
